definitions: Don't try to deceive or fool someone who is an expert at deceiving or fooling others.
It's pointless to attempt to trick someone who is known for being a trickster themselves.
examples: You're trying to pull a fast one on me? Don't kid a kidder!
He thought he could trick the seasoned negotiator, but you can't kid a kidder.
I've been in sales for years, so don't kid a kidder with that offer.
